This code will use a formula and calculate MElaS at A, B and C weeks for each metabolite at different conditions. A new csv file will be created that includes these MElaS values.

```{r, echo=FALSE, out.width="50%", fig.align="center", fig.cap="Your Caption"}
knitr::include_graphics("~/Desktop/Metabolic_Elascity_Score_Project/MElaS_explained.png")
```

## Install and load packages

```{r}
#install.packages("matrixStats")
library(matrixStats) # version 0.58.0

#install.packages("data.table")
library(data.table) # version 1.14.3

#install.packages("dplyr")
library(dplyr) # version 1.1.4

#install.packages("stringr")
library(stringr) # version 1.5.1

```

## Import data that includes FC and p-values of all metabolites

```{r}
FC_values <- read.csv("MElaS_FC_pvalues.csv")
```

## Calculate MElaS 

```{r}
# Rename the names of your FC and p-values from your FC conversion file
colnames(FC_values)[colnames(FC_values) == "logFC_3v0"] <- "BvA"
colnames(FC_values)[colnames(FC_values) == "logFC_24v3"] <- "CvB"
colnames(FC_values)[colnames(FC_values) == "adj.P.Val_24v3"] <- "P_valueCvB"

MElaS_Values <- FC_values %>%
  mutate(

    # Sign term: determined dynamics
    Sign = ifelse(BvA * CvB < 0, 1, 0),

    # Ratio term: determined restoration and if FC have equal magnitutude  
    Ratio = ifelse(
      pmax(abs(BvA), abs(CvB)) == 0,
      0,
      pmin(abs(BvA), abs(CvB)) /
            pmax(abs(BvA), abs(CvB))),

    # P-value weight: statistical significance weight
    P_valueCvB_weight = ifelse(
      P_valueCvB < 0.05,
      1,
      log10(P_valueCvB) / log10(0.05)
    ),

    # Calculate MElaS value using sign, ration and p-value weight
    MElaS = Sign *
            (abs(BvA) +
             abs(CvB) * P_valueCvB_weight) *
            Ratio
  )

# Export MElaS values as a csv
write.csv(MElaS_Values, "MElaS_Values.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```
